documents.scope: Three linked locally reported preparations required for primary Q-LHD/0.5: LHD conjugate including DOCA functionalization, CdTe/CdSe core/shell QDs including CdTe core, and loading0.5mL source QD solution into50mg LHD. Source explicitly selects /0.5 in p.5; other formulations/applications pending. Independent scoped audit accepted. Public read flags refer only to core pages1-5; private author history separately records text pages1-8. No original SI was read by this author.

source_conflicts: DOCA is named sodium deoxycholic acid in Materials but deoxycholic acid in the method; exact salt/acid identity is unresolved.
Opening method describes DOCA hydroxyl coupling, whereas the operational sequence and Results use aminated DOCA/amine groups; an exact conjugate linkage is unassigned.
Cadmium stock is reported both as0.1g CdCl2 in3mL TOP and as a resulting0.2M solution; both are retained without reconciling final volume or hydration.
Source QD concentration is printed0.112muM/mL; this ambiguous dimensional notation is retained and no molar loading charge is inferred.

Generic Figure3B Q-LHD TEM size is approximately130nm with loading variant unreported, while Table1 explicitly gives primary /0.5 ELS diameter220+/-26.32nm; sample and technique contexts remain separate.
limitations: DOCA carbonate transfer amount and amination solvent unreported.
Wash volumes, rotary-evaporation settings, acetonitrile amount, LMWH water volume, HCl volume and coupling temperature unreported.
LHD dialysis duration, water volume/exchanges and freeze-drying settings unreported.
No exact LMWH sequence, sodium/acid stoichiometry, substitution degree, isolated yield or atomistic conjugate structure.
Source ODPA and TOP full names are retained as printed; no common abbreviation substitution or chemical graph assignment.
Core growth duration/target stopping size, analytical aliquot amounts/times and bulk-core isolation details unreported.
Exact physical relationship of0.02g core charge to preceding batch/aliquots unreported.
Gentle-heating numerical temperature, shell atmosphere/ramp and purification solvents/speeds/times/repetition count unreported.
No measured core/shell dimensions, phase, ligand binding structure, atomistic coordinates or isolated yield.
QD stock concentration notation unresolved; exact QD molar or mass loading charge unreported.
Dissolution/loading temperatures, stirring speed and numerical overnight duration unreported.
Vacuum evaporation pressure/time/temperature and loading-dialysis membrane specification/water volume unreported.
Hydrophobic-filter material/pore size and freeze-drying pressure/temperature unreported.
Exact physical batches across preparations, ELS, fluorescence and TEM unreported; Figure3B loading variant unresolved.
